messages:
noah: Quick copy ping  we have a compact empty-state banner for Project Logs when retention is on the Starter plan (7 days). Need language thats calm, clear about current limits, and nudges to upgrade without fear. Options below.

talia (PM): Short + factual. Users should immediately know what they can see and what the CTA does.

ash (Infra): Legal asked us not to imply irreversible deletion in banners. If logs are moved or not surfaced, say so plainly.

copybot: Accessibility tip: avoid CTAs that are only a verb. Use something like "View plan options" or "Compare plans". Also ensure button has an aria-label describing destination.

noah: Draft A (plain):
```
Currently showing 7 days of logs.
Choose a plan to keep logs for longer and view extended traces.
[See plan options]
```

talia: I like this but "Currently showing" maybe a bit passive. Can we be more direct?

noah: Draft B (direct):
```
Youre viewing logs from the last 7 days.
Select a plan to keep logs beyond 7 days and unlock longer trace history.
[Compare plans]
```

ash: "Unlock" sounds salesy. Maybe "access" instead. Also, add a tiny admin tooltip: "Retention is set per project." Keeps support low.

noah: Draft C (soft nudge):
```
Logs in the Console show the last 7 days by default.
Need older logs? Choose a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer trace history.
[View plan options]
```

copybot: Suggestion: prefer "Choose a plan" -> "Select a plan" for neutrality. CTA label recommendation: "View plan options" which reads well with screen readers.

talia: Can we avoid repeating "logs" too many times in two lines? Also add a short second-line microcopy for admins.

noah: Revised candidate (compact, avoid repetition):
```
Console shows the last 7 days of logs by default.
Select a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer traces for debugging.
[View plan options]

Admin tooltip: Retention is configured per project and may vary by plan.
```

ash: That reads better. One implementation note: the CTA should link directly to the pricing retention matrix. We should make that visible in the analytics click-through.

maria (Design QA): Accessibility pass notes: button text = "View plan options" is good. For keyboard users, make sure the tooltip is accessible via focus and has aria-describedby on the CTA. Also avoid starting the sentence with the CTA word — keeps SR flow smoother.

talia: Final ask: can we keep the header line to one sentence only and put the action in the second? The revised candidate does that.

noah: Cool. I'll drop this into the banner component and push to Figma with the admin tooltip variation. Final copy we'll use in components library:
```
Console shows the last 7 days of logs by default.
Select a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer traces for debugging.
[View plan options]

Admin tooltip: Retention is configured per project and may vary by plan.
```

maria: I'll run VoiceOver/NVDA checks on the staging banner once it's deployed. tag me when live.

ash: I'll wire the CTA to the retention matrix URL and add UTM to track clicks.

noah: Thanks everyone 44D tagging this as ready for design QA unless any objections.
